units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 5:13">Tosef. Sot. V, 13</cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 56b:8">Erub. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>מגרש ר׳</he> the pasture ground of Levitic townships was one-fourth of the area; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 5:3:2">Y. Sot. V, 20ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ר׳ מגרש</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 5:3:2">Ib.</cite> <he>ר׳ מאלף</he> it means a square of one thousand cubits; <he>אפי׳ תימא ר׳ מכל צד ר׳ חוא</he> even if you say that it means ‘square’, at all events it is one-fourth of the area.
<cite ref="Gittin 58b:15">Ib. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>ר׳ בקרקע או ר׳ וכ׳</he> one-fourth of the property bought, or one-fourth of the purchase price.
Y. Pes. X, 37ᶜ top, a. e., v. טִיטַרְטוֹן; a. fr.—Pl. רְבִיעִין blocks.
<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 3:5">Midd. III, 5</cite> <he>ר׳ של ארז וכ׳</he> (Bart. <he>רִבּוּעִין</he>) cedar blocks were on top (of the columns).

<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 3:5">Tam. III, 5</cite> <cite ref="T00107"><he>רְבִיעִית</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Ta'anit 1:4">Tosef. Taan. I, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="T00101"><he>רְבִיעָה</he></cite>.]
